name: prompt-engineering
description: Design, version, and optimize LLM prompts — few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, role framing, constraint injection, A/B testing, and prompt version management. Use when asked to "write a system prompt", "improve this prompt", "prompt isn't working", "add few-shot examples", "prompt A/B test", or "how do I get better outputs from the model". Do NOT use for: RAG retrieval design — use `rag-architect`. UI for streaming responses — use `llm-ui-patterns`.
